utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still checking on the timing and drop-off spot — can you tell me if anything else got added to the repair list?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure anything new got added, but I might be forgetting—what’s on the list so far? If there’s a spot or time update, let me know and I’ll help track it down.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Right now it’s the broken shelf, a loose door hinge, and a couple of lamps that need rewiring. I’m still trying to confirm the timing and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’m still keeping an ear out for the repair drive. If you hear anything, I’d appreciate you passing it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll keep an ear out too, and if I hear any updates, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Hana — I really appreciate it. I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s still today as far as I know—I’m just a bit unsure on the exact drop-off details. If I hear anything new, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, thanks — so it’s still on today, just the drop-off details are a bit unclear? Let me know if you confirm them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that’s right — still on today, but I’m not fully sure about the drop-off spot yet. I’ll let you know if I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I still don’t have it on my list—where did you last see the repair drive, and was it by the front steps?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, I’m late again — I haven’t seen the repair drive list myself. Was it left by the front steps or near the spot with the tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I last had it by the front steps, so I’ll check there again. If it’s not there, I’ll look near the tools next.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll swing by after school pickup and check by the front porch, then let you know if I find the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—please let me know what you find by the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check right after pickup and update you as soon as I know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word and point people to the front porch this Saturday. What details should I share with Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules—please tell folks the repair drive is this Saturday on the front porch, and they can bring any small fix-it items they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll tell people it’s this Saturday on the front porch and to bring any small fix-it items they need help with.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, I’ll keep it simple and let folks know it’s the repair drive, with exact time and place to follow.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll check the notice so I can pass along the exact spot when I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Noah — I’ll keep spreading the word and point everyone to the notice for the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ll bring the hammer and screwdriver by the repair drive spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks, Bo. I’ll be by the front steps to sort everything when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’m on my way over now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s on Sunday at the community center, Opal — I’ve got it listed there now. I can also send you the details if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — that works for me. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Glad to hear it, Cleo — I’ll see you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, it’s already getting a nice little turnout, so if you’ve got anything to donate, now’s a good time to bring it by. I’ll keep passing along any new updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Got it — I’ll bring what I have by around 6 and keep an ear out for updates too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds perfect—thanks, Mara. I’ll let you know if I hear anything new about the drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep sorting the tools and let you know what’s still missing for the repair drive. If you get the details, send them my way and I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. If I hear the details, I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep sorting the tools and watching for any missing bits. Let me know when the repair-drive details come in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What still needs fixing for the repair drive? I can bring the screws by and help out too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — screws would be great, and if you can help organize the tools when you get here, that’d be a big help too. I’m still keeping an ear out for any updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I’ll bring the screws and help organize the tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout already. If you’ve got anything to donate, now’d be a good time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great to hear — I can bring over a few tools and some screws. I’m still checking on the details, so I’ll pass along anything new I hear.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Ira—that’d be really helpful. And yes, please do pass along any new details when you hear them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help check who still needs tools or supplies. I’m a bit tied up, but I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—could you check by the front porch and front steps first? That’s where I last noted the repair drive stuff.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can do that. I’ll check the front porch and front steps first and let you know what’s still there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. Can you help me spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure, I can spread the word. What time on Sunday should I tell people to come?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Eli — please tell folks to come by 2 PM on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Mara — I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I’m keeping an ear out for updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Nell — that’d really help. If you can, bring any spare tools, tape, and batteries you’ve got, and swing by around 6 so we can sort everything out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll bring what I can and stop by around 6.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive spot soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — a hammer and screwdriver would be perfect if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ve got both, and I’ll bring them by soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—what still needs fixing for the repair drive? Just remind me what you still need from me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mostly just a quick reminder on the time, and if you can keep helping spread the word, that’d be great too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — just send me the time again, and I can keep helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I could still use a few more tools and screws for the repair drive, and it’s at the community center on Sunday now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll spread the word and see if I can round up a few more tools and screws for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus — I really appreciate it. If you find any extra screwdrivers or a hammer, those would be especially helpful.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Rey — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just let me know what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam — I’ll check what’s still needed and let you know. I can bring the screws by and help with the repair drive too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great, Rey — thanks. Just let me know when and where to meet, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still sorting the details after school pickup, but I can definitely help coordinate. If you hear where the repair drive materials are, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check by the front steps again for the list and materials. If I find them, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I appreciate it. If you find the list by the front steps, just let me know and I’ll coordinate from there after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane — not much yet, just figuring out what still needs fixing and who’s bringing what. I’ll repeat the repair-drive details once they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik — I’ll wait for the final details, then I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, Hana — once the repair-drive details are set, I’ll pass them along and help keep everyone updated.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it’s still today — I’m a bit fuzzy on the exact time and drop-off spot, though. If you check the notice, that should clear it up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just checking — do you want me to look at the notice for the exact time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, please do — I’d appreciate it. I’m pretty sure it’s still on today, but the notice should have the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the timing nearly set — what drop-off spot works best for you?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The front porch works best for me — thanks! If you can, please share that along with the timing once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll send the timing and front porch drop-off as soon as it’s confirmed.
